mapper.select: select t.SEQNO, t.jycs, t.ACCOUNTID, t.CSTPID, t.CFETSID, t.CFETSNAME, t.EFFECTFLAG, t.CREATORID, t.CREATEDTIME, t.LASTMODIFIERID, t.LASTMODIFIEDTIME from fx_imix_account_info t where 1=1 and t.accountid = #{accountid} and t.effectflag = #{effectflag} and t.cfetsid like '%'||#{cfetsid} ||'%'

SELECT t.finprod_id id,t.finprod_name text FROM fin_product t WHERE 1=1 and t.finprod_type = 'F16'
AND (t.finprod_id like #{search} || '%' or t.finprod_name like #{search} || '%')

SELECT f.jycyid text,f.zwjc id FROM FX_IMIX_MEM_INFO f WHERE 1=1
AND (f.jycyid like #{search} || '%' or f.zwjc like #{search} || '%')

select t.item_code id ,t.item_value text from sys_datadict_list t where t.dict_code='EFFECTFALG'
AND (t.item_value like #{search} || '%' or t.item_code like #{search} || '%')

select t.item_code id ,t.item_value text from sys_datadict_list t where t.dict_code='JYCS'
AND (t.item_value like #{search} || '%' or t.item_code like #{search} || '%')
mapper.insert: insert into FX_IMIX_ACCOUNT_INFO (SEQNO, jycs, ACCOUNTID, CSTPID, CFETSID, CFETSNAME, EFFECTFLAG, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME, LASTMODIFIERID, LASTMODIFIEDTIME )values ( #{seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jycs,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cstpid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cfetsid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cfetsname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{effectflag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creatorid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate, #{lastmodifierid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lastmodifiedtime,jdbcType=DATE})
mapper.select: SELECT f.jgdm FROM FX_IMIX_MEM_INFO f where f.jycyid=#{value}

select t.SEQNO, t.jycs, t.ACCOUNTID, t.CSTPID, t.CFETSID, t.CFETSNAME, t.EFFECTFLAG, t.CREATORID, t.CREATEDTIME, t.LASTMODIFIERID, t.LASTMODIFIEDTIME from fx_imix_account_info t where t.SEQNO=#{value}
mapper.update: update fx_imix_account_info f set f.EFFECTFLAG='D' where f.seqno=#{value}

update fx_imix_account_info t set t.jycs=#{jycs}, t.ACCOUNTID=#{accountid}, t.CSTPID=#{cstpid}, t.CFETSID=#{cfetsid}, t.LASTMODIFIERID=#{lastmodifierid}, t.LASTMODIFIEDTIME=sysdate where t.seqno=#{seqno}
mapper.select: select count(1) from fx_imix_account_info t where t.ACCOUNTID=#{value} and t.EFFECTFLAG='E'
